### Summary

I found nothing to flag. The change is a one-line pin bump from niway-dev/wachiman v1.3.0 to v1.4.0, plus a dated paragraph added to ADR 0028's last amendment. The paragraph is added under the 2026-11-01 amendment and leaves the earlier text alone, so the ADR stays append-only. It also correctly limits the earlier list of known costs: a rebase that changes content still triggers a full review, and there is still no per-pull-request limit. The workflow keeps its triggers, permissions, inputs and secret. I could not check two things because the reusable workflow lives in another repository: what v1.4.0 does, and whether it still accepts the `operator` and `model` inputs. That question is recorded as an open contract, not as a finding.

> ℹ️ No critical issues. One small docs gap below. **Reviewed changes** Reviewed the pin bump against the upstream `review.yml` diff between `v1.3.0` and `v1.4.0`, and checked the ADR 0028 paragraph against the `v1.4.0` release notes. - **Pin bump to `v1.4.0`**: the only interface changes are four new inputs, all with defaults (`effort: high`, `max_turns: 40`, `call_timeout_s: 900`, `review_on_push: true`). Required inputs (`operator`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) and per-job `permissions` are unchanged, so the caller as written still works, and push reviews stay on. - **ADR 0028 dated paragraph**: every behavior it claims (no model call on a rebase with no content change, a base merge reviews no base files, the effort footer, turn and timeout caps, sibling call sites, confidence) matches the release notes. ### ℹ️ ADR 0028's Status row does not mention the `v1.4.0` pin Every earlier amendment to ADR 0028 also added a dated entry to the Status row, which is the one place that lists what changed and when. The 2026-11-02 paragraph is nested inside the 2026-11-01 section, so the Status row still ends at "Amended 2026-11-01: reviews also run on every push". Someone reading only the Status row will not see that the engine pin moved.
Technical details ````markdown # ADR 0028 Status row misses the 2026-11-02 pin bump ## Affected sites - apps/documentation/src/content/docs/architecture/decisions/0028-advisory-claude-review-on-pull-requests.mdx:12 — Status cell ends at the 2026-11-01 amendment ## Required outcome - The Status cell names the 2026-11-02 change (pin moved to `v1.4.0`), linking to the amendment section, the same way the 2026-10-27 and 2026-11-01 entries do. ## Suggested approach (optional) - Append e.g. `; 2026-11-02: pinned to v1.4.0 ([amendment](#amendment-reviews-also-run-on-every-push))` to the Status cell, or give the 2026-11-02 paragraph its own `## Amendment:` heading and link that. Re-run oxfmt afterwards, since it will re-pad the whole table. ````
